description: Button widget. A clickable button that triggers an action.

text.description: Button text. Supports template expressions. Legacy alias: label.

label.description: Legacy alias of text (frontend renders text ?? label).

icon.description: Optional icon name (play, plus, download, upload, trash, edit, save, search, refresh, arrowRight, check, close, filter, settings, chevronDown)

alignment.description: Horizontal alignment of the button in its row

fullWidth.description: Stretch button to fill the row width

disabled.description: Disabled state — boolean or template expression

isLoading.description: Loading overlay — boolean or template expression (e.g. {{ state.queries.myQuery.isLoading }}). Legacy alias: loading.
